title: The origin marker survives a unit write
statement: Let $u:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{OblSymbol})$ be a tape and let $v\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy $1\le v$. Suppose $u(z)$ is the origin marker exactly when $z=0$. After updating the tape at position $v$ to the unit marker, its value is still the origin marker exactly at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Tape $u$ from integers to optional schedule symbols
The tape has the origin marker exactly at coordinate $0$
replaced:
If a tape carries the origin sentinel exactly at coordinate $0$, then after
writing a unit marker at any coordinate $u \ge 1$ it still carries the origin
sentinel exactly at coordinate $0$.
